Story: Project scaffold: React (Vite) + Express + Mongoose, ESLint, .env.example, module folders
Acceptance criteria: App boots locally; folders follow SAD 4.1 (routes/controllers -> services -> repositories); no secrets committed

Story: GitHub Actions CI: lint + tests on every PR
Acceptance criteria: Workflow runs on pull_request; failing lint/test blocks merge

Story: Seed script: 1,000 books, 3 customers, 1 admin
Acceptance criteria: One command seeds the DB; books span Fiction, Non-fiction, Academic

Story: Register API with unique email and bcrypt password hash
Acceptance criteria: 201 on success; 409 EMAIL_EXISTS; stored hash is 60-char bcrypt; 8-char min password

Story: Login API issuing JWT (role claim, 1 h expiry)
Acceptance criteria: 200 with token/role/expiresIn; 401 generic message on bad credentials

Story: Register / Login UI
Acceptance criteria: Customer can register, log in, log out; token kept in session storage

Story: JWT verification middleware
Acceptance criteria: Missing/expired/tampered token returns 401 on protected routes

Story: RBAC middleware for /admin routes
Acceptance criteria: Customer token gets 403 on every /admin endpoint

Story: Sprint 1 demo video (1 min) uploaded to repo
Acceptance criteria: Video shows working product; file committed to repo

Story: Browse catalog API (public, paginated, limit <= 50)
Acceptance criteria: GET /books works without login; limit 51 rejected or capped

Story: Search by title, author or category
Acceptance criteria: Matching books only; no-match returns empty list; injection payloads treated as text

Story: Book detail API and page
Acceptance criteria: Shows title, author, category, price, stock status, description, cover; 404 for unknown/disabled

Story: Catalog UI: home, search results, book cards, out-of-stock label
Acceptance criteria: Responsive; Add to cart disabled when stock = 0

Story: Add in-stock book to cart (login required)
Acceptance criteria: Out-of-stock gives 409; unauthenticated gives 401

Story: Update quantity / remove cart item
Acceptance criteria: Qty 0/-1 gives 422; qty above stock gives 409

Story: Cart total calculation (price x quantity)
Cart UI
Acceptance criteria: Edit qty, remove items, see total

Story: Payment adapter + mock payment service (SUCCESS / DECLINED / TIMEOUT)
Acceptance criteria: Adapter interface stubbed in tests; no card data anywhere

Story: Checkout API: validation, unique order number, stock reservation
Acceptance criteria: Empty cart/missing address rejected; address <= 300 chars; order number unique; decline creates no confirmed order

Story: Admin: add / edit / disable books API
Acceptance criteria: Admin only; invalid data gives 422; disabled books hidden from customers

Story: Admin: update stock quantity API
Acceptance criteria: Stock >= 0; negative gives 422

Story: Admin catalog management UI
Acceptance criteria: Add, edit, disable, stock update from dashboard

Story: Input validation and sanitisation (express-validator, mongo-sanitize, length limits)
Acceptance criteria: Operator injection and script payloads neutralised; limits per SRS Appendix B

Story: Central error envelope, helmet headers, request logging
Acceptance criteria: All errors use standard envelope; no stack traces to clients

Story: Security event logging and login rate limit
Acceptance criteria: Failed login/unauthorised access logged; 11th login in 15 min gives 429

Story: Verify no payment card data stored (schema/log review)
Acceptance criteria: Only paymentStatus and paymentRef persisted

Story: Auth and security tests (TC-AUTH, TC-SEC)
Acceptance criteria: Tests run in CI and pass

Story: Update SRS/SAD/RTM for Auth module; document deviations
Acceptance criteria: Deviations written down for final demo

Story: Search performance: indexes + JMeter plan (50 users)
Acceptance criteria: p95 <= 1.5 s, error rate < 1%

Story: Catalog tests (TC-CAT)
Acceptance criteria: Tests run in CI and pass

Story: Postman collection run in CI
Acceptance criteria: Collection covers main endpoints; Newman step in workflow

Story: Health endpoint (/health) and uptime check
Acceptance criteria: GET /health returns 200, 503 when DB is down; uptime log kept

Story: Usability walkthrough: order in <= 5 screens
Acceptance criteria: Results recorded for test users

Story: Update docs for Catalog module; document deviations
Acceptance criteria: Deviations written down for final demo

Story: Sprint 2 demo video (2 min) uploaded to repo
Acceptance criteria: Working product; file committed to repo

Story: Idempotency-Key on POST /orders (retry-safe)
Acceptance criteria: Retry after timeout yields exactly one order; replay returns 200

Story: Order history and order detail (own orders only)
Acceptance criteria: Other customer's order gives 404; empty history handled

Story: Customer cancels own PLACED order (stock restored)
Acceptance criteria: Cancel after PROCESSING gives 409

Story: Checkout, confirmation and order history UI
Acceptance criteria: Basic purchase within 5 primary screens

Story: Cart and order tests (TC-CART, TC-ORD, TC-TRK, TC-TST)
Acceptance criteria: Tests run in CI and pass

Story: Update docs for Cart & Checkout; document deviations
Acceptance criteria: Deviations written down for final demo

Story: Order status state machine (PLACED..CANCELLED)
Acceptance criteria: Invalid transition gives 409; statusHistory records actor/time

Story: Admin order list and status update API
Acceptance criteria: Filter by status; customer sees staff-set status

Story: Admin order management UI
Acceptance criteria: Incoming orders and status update from dashboard

Story: Dockerfile + docker-compose
Acceptance criteria: App and DB start with one command

Story: Static analysis and npm audit in CI
Acceptance criteria: Scan step in workflow

Story: Admin tests (TC-ADM) and development freeze
Acceptance criteria: Tests pass; main frozen at end of Sprint 2

Story: Update docs for Admin module; document deviations
Acceptance criteria: Deviations written down for final demo
